verdict.rationale: Pipedream ships an official, documented `pd` CLI. Its reference docs cover deploying event sources from local or remote code, live-syncing local files with `pd dev`, streaming emitted events to the terminal, and built-in `pd help` docs. missing for 10: evidence of agent-friendly CLI features (machine-readable output, non-interactive flags), CLI coverage beyond sources/components such as workflow or Connect management, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Run `pd` to see a list of all commands with basic usage info, or run `pd help <command>` to display help docs for a specific command.

pd dev will link your local file with the deployed component and watch your local file for changes. When you save changes to your local file, your component will automatically be updated on Pipedream.
Returns historical events sent to a source, and streams emitted events directly to the CLI.
Deploy an event source from local or remote code.
